verdict.rationale: Every Fivetran capability in the evidence moves data into a warehouse or data lake from applications, databases, and files. Nothing documents syncing modeled warehouse data back out to CRM, ads, or support tools. A community comment contrasts Fivetran (APIs into databases) with Census (databases out to APIs), which reinforces that reverse-ETL activation is not evidenced here.

support.subject: As an analytics engineer, I sync modeled warehouse data back into SaaS tools (CRM, ads, support) to activate it where teams work
